summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI technology, partnerships, and applications. Google and Apple are making strides in AI-powered health coaching and custom AI models. OpenAI is introducing new features and partnerships to bolster its enterprise AI push.
insight: The increasing collaboration between tech giants and AI startups is driving innovation and shaping the future of AI, with a focus on improving efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility.
highlights: Google partners with Abbott to integrate continuous glucose monitoring data with AI-powered health coaching tools
OpenAI introduces 'Ultrafast' mode, making GPT-5.6 Sol work 14x faster, and partners with IBM to train and certify consultants
Apple trains a custom AI model for the China market with help from Alibaba, marking a rare cross-border partnership
